source.text: דְּבַר־יְהוָ֣ה׀אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־הוֹשֵׁ֨עַ֙ בֶּן־בְּאֵרִ֔י בִּימֵ֨י עֻזִּיָּ֥ה יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֛י יָרָבְעָ֥ם בֶּן־יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] word of Yahweh which came to Hosea son of Beeri in [the] days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in [the] days of Jeroboam son of Joash, king of Israel.

en.L: The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} which came to Hosea son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam son of Joash, king of Israel.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s word came to Hosea son of Beeri during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah over Judah, and during the reign of Jeroboam son of Joash over Israel.
en.R: This is the message {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave to Hosea son of Beeri. It came while Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah, and while Jeroboam son of Joash was king of Israel.

fr.L: La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qui fut adressée à Osée fils de Beéri, aux jours d’Ozias, de Jotham, d’Achaz, d’Ézéchias, rois de Juda, et aux jours de Jéroboam fils de Joas, roi d’Israël.
fr.B: La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut adressée à Osée fils de Beéri sous le règne d’Ozias, de Jotham, d’Achaz et d’Ézéchias, rois de Juda, et sous le règne de Jéroboam fils de Joas, roi d’Israël.
fr.R: Voici le message que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné à Osée fils de Beéri. Ce message est venu quand Ozias, Jotham, Achaz et Ézéchias étaient rois de Juda, et quand Jéroboam fils de Joas était roi d’Israël.

sw.L: Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lililomjia Hosea mwana wa Beeri katika siku za Uzia, Yothamu, Ahazi, Hezekia, wafalme wa Yuda, na katika siku za Yeroboamu mwana wa Yoashi, mfalme wa Israeli.
sw.B: Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilimjia Hosea mwana wa Beeri wakati wa utawala wa Uzia, Yothamu, Ahazi na Hezekia juu ya Yuda, na wakati wa utawala wa Yeroboamu mwana wa Yoashi juu ya Israeli.
sw.R: Huu ndio ujumbe ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpa Hosea mwana wa Beeri. Ulimjia wakati Uzia, Yothamu, Ahazi na Hezekia walipokuwa wafalme wa Yuda, na wakati Yeroboamu mwana wa Yoashi alipokuwa mfalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đến với Ô-sê con trai Bê-ê-ri trong đời Ô-xia, Giô-tham, A-cha, Ê-xê-chia, các vua Giu-đa, và trong đời Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Giô-ách, vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Ô-sê con trai Bê-ê-ri dưới triều Ô-xia, Giô-tham, A-cha và Ê-xê-chia, các vua Giu-đa, và dưới triều Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Giô-ách, vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Đây là sứ điệp {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho Ô-sê con trai Bê-ê-ri. Sứ điệp ấy đến khi Ô-xia, Giô-tham, A-cha và Ê-xê-chia làm vua Giu-đa, và khi Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Giô-ách làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

es.L: Palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que vino a Oseas hijo de Beerí en los días de Uzías, Jotam, Acaz [y] Ezequías, reyes de Judá, y en los días de Jeroboam hijo de Joás, rey de Israel.
es.B: Este mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a Oseas hijo de Beerí durante el reinado de Uzías, Jotam, Acaz y Ezequías en Judá, y durante el reinado de Jeroboam hijo de Joás en Israel.
es.R: Este es el mensaje que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio a Oseas hijo de Beerí. Le llegó cuando Uzías, Jotam, Acaz y Ezequías eran reyes de Judá, y cuando Jeroboam hijo de Joás era rey de Israel.

ko.L: 유다 왕들인 웃시야와 요담과 아하스와 히스기야의 시대에, 그리고 요아스의 아들 이스라엘 왕 여로보암의 시대에 브에리의 아들 호세아에게 임한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 브에리의 아들 호세아에게 임했다. 그때는 웃시야와 요담과 아하스와 히스기야가 유다를 다스리고, 요아스의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘을 다스리던 때였다.
ko.R: 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 브에리의 아들 호세아에게 주신 말씀이다. 이 말씀은 웃시야와 요담과 아하스와 히스기야가 유다의 왕이었고, 요아스의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘의 왕이었을 때에 임했다.

pt.L: A palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que veio a Oseias, filho de Beeri, nos dias de Uzias, Jotão, Acaz [e] Ezequias, reis de Judá, e nos dias de Jeroboão, filho de Jeoás, rei de Israel.
pt.B: A palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} veio a Oseias, filho de Beeri, durante os reinados de Uzias, Jotão, Acaz e Ezequias sobre Judá, e durante o reinado de Jeroboão, filho de Jeoás, sobre Israel.
pt.R: Esta é a mensagem que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu a Oseias, filho de Beeri. Ela veio quando Uzias, Jotão, Acaz e Ezequias eram reis de Judá, e quando Jeroboão, filho de Jeoás, era rei de Israel.

am.L: በይሁዳ ነገሥታት በዖዝያ፣ በኢዮአታም፣ በአካዝ፣ በሕዝቅያስ ዘመን፣ በእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በኢዮአስ ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም ዘመን ወደ ብኤሪ ልጅ ወደ ሆሴዕ የመጣው {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል።
am.B: ዖዝያ፣ ኢዮአታም፣ አካዝና ሕዝቅያስ በይሁዳ ላይ በነገሡበት ዘመን፣ የኢዮአስ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓምም በእስራኤል ላይ በነገሠበት ዘመን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ወደ ብኤሪ ልጅ ወደ ሆሴዕ መጣ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለብኤሪ ልጅ ለሆሴዕ የሰጠው መልእክት ይህ ነው። መልእክቱ የመጣው ዖዝያ፣ ኢዮአታም፣ አካዝና ሕዝቅያስ የይሁዳ ነገሥታት በነበሩበት ጊዜ፣ የኢዮአስ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓምም የእስራኤል ንጉሥ በነበረበት ጊዜ ነው።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन जो बेरी के पुत्र होशे के पास यहूदा के राजाओं उज्जियाह, योताम, आहाज़ [और] हिजकिय्याह के दिनों में, और इस्राएल के राजा योआश के पुत्र यारोबाम के दिनों में पहुँचा।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन बेरी के पुत्र होशे के पास पहुँचा, जब यहूदा पर उज्जियाह, योताम, आहाज़ और हिजकिय्याह का शासनकाल था, और इस्राएल पर योआश के पुत्र यारोबाम का शासनकाल था।
hi.R: यह वह संदेश है जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने बेरी के बेटे होशे को दिया। यह संदेश उस समय मिला जब उज्जियाह, योताम, आहाज़ और हिजकिय्याह यहूदा के राजा थे, और योआश का बेटा यारोबाम इस्राएल का राजा था।

ru.L: Слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, которое было к Осии, сыну Беэра, во дни Озии, Иоафама, Ахаза, Езекии, царей Иудейских, и во дни Иеровоама, сына Иоаса, царя Израильского.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} обратился к Осии, сыну Беэра, в царствование Озии, Иоафама, Ахаза и Езекии над Иудой и в царствование Иеровоама, сына Иоаса, над Израилем.
ru.R: Вот слово, которое {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал Осии, сыну Беэра. Оно пришло, когда царями Иуды были Озия, Иоафам, Ахаз и Езекия, а царём Израиля был Иеровоам, сын Иоаса.

uk.L: Слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, що було до Осії, сина Беері, за днів Озії, Йоатама, Ахаза, Єзекії, царів Юдеї, і за днів Єровоама, сина Йоаша, царя Ізраїля.
uk.B: Слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} було до Осії, сина Беері, за царювання Озії, Йоатама, Ахаза і Єзекії над Юдеєю і за царювання Єровоама, сина Йоаша, над Ізраїлем.
uk.R: Це послання, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав Осії, синові Беері. Воно прийшло тоді, коли Озія, Йоатам, Ахаз і Єзекія були царями Юдеї, а Єровоам, син Йоаша, був царем Ізраїля.

decisions.choice: the kings named date Hosea's work to the eighth century BC, from the last years of Jeroboam II into the reign of Hezekiah
decisions.reason: Jeroboam son of Joash is Jeroboam II, who ruled the northern kingdom of Israel from about 793 to 753 BC (2 Kings 14:23-29), not Jeroboam son of Nebat, Israel's first king. The kings of Judah named are the same four as in Isaiah 1:1: Uzziah (about 792-740 BC), Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah (who began to reign about 715 BC). So Hosea spoke from the prosperous last years of Jeroboam II, through the turmoil that followed, and probably past the fall of Samaria to Assyria in 722 BC. The heading names only one king of Israel, although six more reigned after Jeroboam before the kingdom ended (2 Kings 15:8-17:6). It does not say why; the list of Judah's kings carries the dating on.

decisions.choice: Hosea son of Beeri: the prophet, known only from this book
decisions.reason: Nothing is known of Hosea or his father Beeri beyond this book. His name means "salvation" or "he has saved", from the same root as the names Joshua and Jesus. It is spelled the same as the name of Hoshea, the last king of Israel (2 Kings 17:1). Hosea is the only one of the writing prophets who came from the northern kingdom and spoke mainly to it.

decisions.choice: the word of the LORD that came to Hosea: the heading of the whole book
decisions.reason: The same heading opens Joel, Micah and Zephaniah. It presents everything that follows, the account of Hosea's marriage and the poems, as one message from the LORD, given through a particular man at a particular time.

decisions.choice: The word of the LORD which came to (L); The LORD's word came to (B); in the days of (L), during the reigns of (B), while ... were kings (R)
decisions.reason: The heading follows the wording set for the Twelve, which follows the Jeremiah table for dated headings: "in the days of X" at Literal, "during the reign of X" at Balanced, "while X was king" at Readable. Literal lists the kings of Judah without "and", as the Hebrew does. Readable splits the long heading into two sentences.

decisions.choice: "La parole du SEIGNEUR qui fut adressée à Osée" (L), "La parole du SEIGNEUR fut adressée à Osée" (B), "Voici le message que le SEIGNEUR a donné à Osée" (R); the prophet is "Osée fils de Beéri"
alternatives: "La parole du SEIGNEUR qui vint à Osée"
decisions.reason: The heading formula of the Twelve, worded as the published French Jeremiah 1:1-2 words it, so that the books open alike; the kings' names are those of the published Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "Lời của CHÚA đã đến với ... trong đời" (L); "Lời CHÚA đến với ... dưới triều" (B); "Đây là sứ điệp CHÚA ban cho ... khi ... làm vua" (R)
decisions.reason: The book heading formula settled in the terms note for Hosea, Joel, Micah and Zephaniah, built on the published Jeremiah 1:2; the older "Đức Giê-hô-va" is not used.

decisions.choice: "Ô-sê con trai Bê-ê-ri"; "Ô-xia, Giô-tham, A-cha, Ê-xê-chia"; "Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Giô-ách"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms already published (Isaiah 1:1; Genesis 26:34 for "Bê-ê-ri"; 2 Kings 14 for Jeroboam son of Joash), used through the book.

decisions.choice: "Palabra del SEÑOR que vino a" (L); "Este mensaje del SEÑOR vino a" (B); "Este es el mensaje que el SEÑOR le dio a" (R); "en los días de" (L), "durante el reinado de" (B), "cuando ... eran reyes" (R)
decisions.reason: The heading of each of the Twelve follows the Spanish of Jeremiah 1:1-2 at each level, as the terms note for these books sets.

decisions.choice: "Oseas hijo de Beerí"; "Uzías, Jotam, Acaz, Ezequías"; "Jeroboam hijo de Joás"
decisions.reason: The names in the forms already published in Spanish (Beerí as Genesis 26:34; the kings as Kings and Chronicles); Oseas is the Spanish name of the prophet, as Romans 9:25 has it.

decisions.choice: Heading: "…호세아에게 임한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀" (L); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 … 호세아에게 임했다" (B); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 … 호세아에게 주신 말씀이다" (R); "브에리의 아들 호세아"
decisions.reason: The book-heading formula set for the prophets (Jeremiah 1:2), with the Protestant spellings 호세아 [Rom 9:25] and 브에리. Every YHWH is the divine_name span; 여호와 is not used.

decisions.choice: "…의 시대에" (L); "…가 다스리던 때" (B); "…가 왕이었을 때" (R)
decisions.reason: The dated-heading formula used in Isaiah and Jeremiah for "in the days of".

decisions.choice: "Neno la BWANA lililomjia ... katika siku za" (L); "lilimjia ... wakati wa utawala wa" (B); "Huu ndio ujumbe ambao BWANA alimpa ... wakati ... walipokuwa wafalme" (R)
decisions.reason: The book-heading formula of the prophets, as Jeremiah 1:1-2 and the term sheet for the Twelve. Recorded once for Hosea and Joel.

decisions.choice: "Hosea"
decisions.reason: The prophet's name as Matthew 2:15 and Romans 9:25 give it, kept apart from King "Hoshea" of 2 Kings 17, whose Hebrew name is the same.

decisions.choice: A palavra do SENHOR que veio a (L); A palavra do SENHOR veio a (B); Esta é a mensagem que o SENHOR deu a (R); nos dias de (L), durante o reinado de (B), quando ... era rei (R); Oseias, filho de Beeri
alternatives: Oseias, filho de Beeri, a quem veio a palavra
decisions.reason: For the whole book, and as the heading for the Twelve: the formula keeps the words Jeremiah 1:2 gives it in Portuguese ("a palavra do SENHOR veio"), and the dated heading keeps Jeremiah's wording per level, as the English does (r-en-1). The prophet is "Oseias", the form Romans 9:25 uses in Portuguese; the kings of Judah are named as in Isaiah 1:1 ("Uzias, Jotão, Acaz e Ezequias"), and Jeroboam son of Joash is "Jeroboão, filho de Jeoás", as in 2 Kings 14:23 and Amos 1:1.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change; the English spans in this chapter have no Amharic counterpart.

decisions.choice: "ሆሴዕ" for Hosea, "ብኤሪ" for Beeri; the kings "ዖዝያ, ኢዮአታም, አካዝ, ሕዝቅያስ" and "የኢዮአስ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓም"
decisions.reason: The prophet's name as the Amharic Romans 9:25 gives it; Beeri as Genesis 26:34; the kings of Judah as Isaiah 1:1, and Jeroboam son of Joash as 2 Kings 14:23. The heading follows the prophets' formula: L "... የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል", B "... ቃል ወደ ... መጣ", R "... የሰጠው መልእክት ይህ ነው".

decisions.choice: होशे, बेरी; उज्जियाह, योताम, आहाज़, हिजकिय्याह; योआश का पुत्र यारोबाम
decisions.reason: Hosea is होशे, the form Romans 9:25 uses in this translation; Beeri is बेरी as Genesis 26:34. The kings keep the forms of 2 Kings 14-20 and Isaiah 1:1 (उज्जियाह, योताम, आहाज़, हिजकिय्याह; योआश का पुत्र यारोबाम, 2 Kings 14:23). Book-wide choice for Hosea.

decisions.choice: प्रभु for both YHWH and Adonai; the divine_name setting tells them apart
decisions.reason: Hindi प्रभु translates both the divine name YHWH and the title Adonai ("Lord"). Wherever the Hebrew has the name, प्रभु stands inside a divine_name span whose alternative is याहवे, so a reader who switches the setting sees which is which; where प्रभु stands alone it is Adonai. यहोवा (the Old Version's form) is not used. God takes honorific plural agreement in both options.

decisions.choice: का वचन ... के पास पहुँचा (L, B); ने ... को यह संदेश दिया (R)
decisions.reason: The heading uses the formula settled for the Prophets ("the word of the LORD came to X"), one wording per level. The dates follow Jeremiah 1:2: "के दिनों में" at Literal, "शासनकाल" at Balanced, "जब ... राजा थे" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "Осия, сын Беэра"; the kings "Озия, Иоафам, Ахаз, Езекия" and "Иеровоам, сын Иоаса"
decisions.reason: Hosea is "Осия" as Romans 9:25 names him in this translation (the same Russian form as King Hoshea of 2 Kings 17, as the Hebrew names are the same). Beeri is "Беэр" as in Genesis 26:34. The kings of Judah keep the forms of Isaiah 1:1 and 2 Kings 15-20, and Jeroboam son of Joash the form of 2 Kings 14:23.

decisions.choice: Слово ГОСПОДА, которое было к X, во дни (L); ГОСПОДЬ обратился к X, в царствование (B); Вот слово, которое ГОСПОДЬ дал X, когда ... были царями (R)
alternatives: И было слово ГОСПОДА к X
decisions.reason: The heading uses the Prophets note's formula for "the word of the LORD came to X" at each level, turned into a heading at Literal and Readable, and the dated-heading wording of Jeremiah 1:2-3 in this translation ("во дни", "в царствование", "когда ... был царём").

source.text: תְּחִלַּ֥ת דִּבֶּר־יְהוָ֖ה בְּהוֹשֵׁ֑עַפוַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־הוֹשֵׁ֗עַ לֵ֣ךְ קַח־לְךָ֞ אֵ֤שֶׁת זְנוּנִים֙ וְיַלְדֵ֣י זְנוּנִ֔ים כִּֽי־זָנֹ֤ה תִזְנֶה֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵֽאַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] beginning of [the] speaking of Yahweh through Hosea: and said Yahweh to Hosea, Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitutions and children of prostitutions, for surely prostitutes itself the land, from after Yahweh.

en.L: The beginning of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s speaking through Hosea: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Hosea, "Go, take yourself a wife of prostitution and children of prostitution, for the land utterly prostitutes itself, [turning] from following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} first spoke through Hosea, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to him, "Go, marry a promiscuous wife and have children born of promiscuity, for the land is wholly given to prostitution; it has turned away from following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: This is how {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} began to speak through Hosea. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to him, "Go and marry a wife who will be unfaithful, and have children born of unfaithfulness. That is what the people of this land have done. They have been completely unfaithful to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and have stopped following {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

fr.L: Commencement de ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit par Osée : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Osée : « Va, prends-toi une femme de prostitution et des enfants de prostitution, car le pays se prostitue entièrement, [en se détournant] de suivre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Lorsque {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} commença à parler par Osée, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui dit : « Va, épouse une femme débauchée et aie des enfants nés de la débauche, car le pays tout entier se prostitue : il a cessé de suivre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Voici comment {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a commencé à parler par Osée. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui a dit : « Va, épouse une femme qui te sera infidèle, et aie des enfants nés de cette infidélité. C’est ce que les gens de ce pays ont fait : ils ont été complètement infidèles {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et ont cessé de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivre. »

sw.L: Mwanzo wa kunena kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kupitia Hosea: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Hosea, "Nenda, ujitwalie mke wa ukahaba na watoto wa ukahaba, kwa maana nchi inafanya ukahaba kabisa, [ikiacha] kumfuata {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipoanza kunena kupitia Hosea, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia, "Nenda, uoe mke mwasherati, uwe na watoto waliozaliwa katika uasherati, kwa maana nchi imejitia kabisa katika ukahaba; imegeuka, haimfuati tena {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoanza kusema kupitia Hosea. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia, "Nenda, uoe mke ambaye hatakuwa mwaminifu, uwe na watoto waliozaliwa katika hali hiyo ya kutokuwa mwaminifu. Ndivyo watu wa nchi hii walivyofanya. Hawajakuwa waaminifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hata kidogo, nao wameacha kumfuata."

vi.L: Khởi đầu lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán qua Ô-sê: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Ô-sê: "Hãy đi, lấy cho ngươi một người vợ đàng điếm và những đứa con đàng điếm, vì xứ này hoàn toàn làm điếm, [quay] khỏi việc đi theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.B: Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bắt đầu phán qua Ô-sê, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với ông: "Hãy đi cưới một người vợ lăng loàn và có những đứa con sinh ra từ sự lăng loàn, vì xứ này đã hoàn toàn làm điếm; nó đã quay lưng, không còn đi theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.R: Đây là cách {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bắt đầu phán qua Ô-sê. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với ông: "Con hãy đi cưới một người vợ sẽ không chung thủy, và có những đứa con sinh ra từ sự không chung thủy ấy. Dân trong xứ này cũng đã làm như vậy. Chúng đã hoàn toàn bất trung với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và không còn đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nữa."

es.L: Comienzo de lo que habló {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} por medio de Oseas. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Oseas: «Ve, tómate una mujer de prostitución e hijos de prostitución, porque la tierra se prostituye por completo, [apartándose] de seguir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}».
es.B: Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} comenzó a hablar por medio de Oseas, le dijo: «Ve, cásate con una esposa promiscua y ten hijos nacidos de la promiscuidad, porque la tierra se prostituye por completo; se ha apartado de seguir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}».
es.R: Así comenzó {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a hablar por medio de Oseas. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo: «Ve y cásate con una esposa que te será infiel, y ten hijos nacidos de esa infidelidad. Eso es lo que ha hecho la gente de esta tierra: ha sido completamente infiel {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y ya no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} sigue».

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 호세아를 통하여 말씀하신 처음: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 호세아에게 말씀하셨다. "가서 음행하는 아내와 음행의 자식들을 네게 맞아들여라. 이 땅이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 떠나 [따르지 않고] 몹시 음행하기 때문이다."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 처음 호세아를 통하여 말씀하실 때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "가서 음란한 아내와 결혼하고, 음란한 가운데 태어난 자식들을 낳아라. 이 땅이 온통 음행에 빠져 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따르지 않고 떠나 버렸기 때문이다."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 호세아를 통하여 말씀하시기 시작하신 것은 이러하다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "가서 신실하지 않을 아내와 결혼하고, 신실하지 않은 가운데 태어난 자식들을 낳아라. 이 땅의 백성이 바로 그렇게 했다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 완전히 신실하지 않았고, 더 이상 그분을 따르지 않는다."

pt.L: O princípio do falar {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} por meio de Oseias: {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Oseias: "Vai, toma para ti uma mulher de prostituição e filhos de prostituição, porque a terra se prostitui inteiramente, [afastando-se] de seguir {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."
pt.B: Quando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} começou a falar por meio de Oseias, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe disse: "Vai, casa com uma mulher promíscua e tem filhos nascidos da promiscuidade, porque a terra se entregou inteiramente à prostituição; ela deixou de seguir {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."
pt.R: Foi assim que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} começou a falar por meio de Oseias. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse a ele: "Vai e casa com uma mulher que vai ser infiel, e tem filhos nascidos da infidelidade. É isso que o povo desta terra tem feito. Eles têm sido completamente infiéis {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e deixaram de segui-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}."

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሆሴዕ በኩል የመናገሩ መጀመሪያ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆሴዕን አለው፦ «ሂድ፤ የዝሙት ሚስትንና የዝሙት ልጆችን ለራስህ ውሰድ፤ ምድሪቱ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ከመከተል [ርቃ] እጅግ ዝሙት ፈጽማለችና።»
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሆሴዕ በኩል መናገር በጀመረ ጊዜ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለው፦ «ሂድ፤ አመንዝራ ሴት አግባ፤ ከዝሙትም የተወለዱ ልጆችን ውለድ፤ ምድሪቱ ፈጽሞ ለዝሙት ተሰጥታለችና፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ከመከተል ዘወር ብላለች።»
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሆሴዕ በኩል መናገር የጀመረው እንዲህ ነው። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለው፦ «ሂድና ታማኝ የማትሆን ሚስት አግባ፤ ከአመንዝራነቷም ልጆችን ውለድ። የዚህች ምድር ሕዝብ ያደረገው ይህንኑ ነው። {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ፈጽሞ ታማኝ አልሆኑም፤ እርሱንም መከተል ትተዋል።»

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के होशे के द्वारा बोलने का आरंभ: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने होशे से कहा, "जाओ, अपने लिए वेश्यावृत्ति की एक पत्नी और वेश्यावृत्ति की सन्तान ले लो, क्योंकि यह देश {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के पीछे चलना छोड़कर पूरी तरह वेश्यावृत्ति कर रहा है।"
hi.B: जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने पहली बार होशे के द्वारा बात की, तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उससे कहा, "जाओ, एक व्यभिचारिणी स्त्री से विवाह करो और व्यभिचार से जन्मी सन्तान पाओ, क्योंकि यह देश पूरी तरह वेश्यावृत्ति में पड़ गया है; वह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के पीछे चलने से फिर गया है।"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने होशे के द्वारा इस तरह बोलना शुरू किया। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उससे कहा, "जाओ और ऐसी स्त्री से विवाह करो जो तुमसे बेवफ़ाई करेगी, और बेवफ़ाई से जन्मी सन्तान पाओ। इस देश के लोगों ने भी यही किया है। वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से पूरी तरह बेवफ़ा हो गए हैं और उन्होंने उनके पीछे चलना छोड़ दिया है।"

ru.L: Начало речи {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} через Осию: и сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Осии: «Иди, возьми себе жену блуда и детей блуда, потому что земля сильно блудит, [отступив] от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.»
ru.B: Когда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} впервые заговорил через Осию, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал ему: «Иди, женись на распутной женщине и роди детей от блуда, потому что вся земля предалась блуду: она отвернулась от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и не следует за {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}.»
ru.R: Вот как {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} начал говорить через Осию. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал ему: «Иди и женись на женщине, которая будет тебе изменять, и пусть у тебя будут дети от неверной жены. Так поступили и люди этой страны. Они совсем изменили {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} и перестали следовать за {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}.»

uk.L: Початок мови {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} через Осію: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав Осії: «Іди, візьми собі жінку розпусти й дітей розпусти, бо земля тяжко розпусничає, [відступивши] від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.»
uk.B: Коли {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} уперше заговорив через Осію, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав йому: «Іди, одружися з розпусною жінкою і май дітей, народжених від розпусти, бо земля цілком віддалася розпусті; вона перестала йти за {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}.»
uk.R: Ось як {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} почав говорити через Осію. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав йому: «Іди й одружися з жінкою, яка буде невірною, і май дітей, народжених від невірності. Так учинили люди цієї землі. Вони стали зовсім невірні {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} й перестали йти за {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}.»

decisions.choice: a wife of prostitution: a woman marked by sexual unfaithfulness; the text does not say whether she was already unfaithful when Hosea married her or became so afterward
alternatives: a woman already unfaithful before the marriage
a woman who would become unfaithful after it
a woman of an unfaithful people
decisions.reason: The phrase does not mean that she was a professional prostitute; the word for a prostitute is not used. The plural noun describes a habit or character of unfaithfulness. Some read the command as it stands: Hosea was told to marry a woman already known to be unfaithful, as a living picture of the LORD's bond with an unfaithful people. Others read it as told looking back: Hosea married Gomer, she later proved unfaithful (as chapter 2 and 3:1 suggest), and the command describes her as she turned out to be. A third reading takes the phrase as belonging to the whole people: any wife Hosea took from this land would share its unfaithfulness to God. The text does not settle the question.

decisions.choice: prostitute oneself: be sexually unfaithful; used of a people's worship of other gods
decisions.reason: The verb is used for sexual unfaithfulness and, very often, for Israel's turning to other gods, pictured as a wife leaving her husband (Exodus 34:15-16; Judges 2:17; Jeremiah 3:1). In Hosea the two senses run together: the prophet's marriage is the picture, and the people's worship of the Baals (2:10, 15) is the reality. The verb is doubled here ("prostituting, it prostitutes itself"), which makes it emphatic.

decisions.choice: the land ... from after the LORD: the people of the land have stopped following the LORD
decisions.reason: "The land" stands for the people who live in it. To walk "after" the LORD is to follow him as his people (Deuteronomy 13:5; Jeremiah 2:2). The land has turned away "from after" him to follow others.

decisions.choice: children of prostitution: children born to such a wife, sharing the name of the unfaithful people
decisions.reason: "Take" governs both the wife and the children: the children come with the marriage. They are called this because of their mother, not for anything they have done. The book does not say plainly whether all three were Hosea's own; 1:3 says that Gomer bore the first son "to him", and 1:6 and 1:8 do not repeat the words.

decisions.choice: the beginning of the LORD's speaking through Hosea: the first part of the LORD's word to Hosea
decisions.reason: The phrase introduces the account of the marriage as the starting point of Hosea's work. The small word translated "through" can also mean "with" or "to" (as Numbers 12:6, 8); "through" fits a heading about the LORD speaking by means of the prophet, whose marriage itself becomes the message.

decisions.choice: a wife of prostitution (L); a promiscuous wife (B); a wife who will be unfaithful (R); prostitutes itself (L, B); unfaithful (R)
decisions.reason: The wording settled for Hosea in the terms note. Readable's "will be unfaithful" says what the marriage would bring; it does not decide whether she had been unfaithful before (m1). Readable says "unfaithful" for the verb, as in Judges 2:17, and spells out that the people of the land have done what the marriage pictures.

decisions.choice: marry (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Take a wife" is the ordinary Hebrew way of saying "marry". Literal keeps "take for yourself".

decisions.choice: "une femme de prostitution" (L), "une femme débauchée" (B), "une femme qui te sera infidèle" (R); "se prostituer" (L, B), "être infidèle" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for Hosea: Literal keeps the Hebrew's abstract plural; Balanced needs a single adjective that does not decide whether Gomer was unfaithful before the marriage, which the meaning decision leaves open; Readable follows the English "unfaithful".

decisions.choice: Hosea 1 and 3 are narrative: passé simple at L and B ("il dit", "elle conçut"), passé composé at R ("il a dit"); the oracles of chapters 2 and 4-14 are speech, with present, future and passé composé at every level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet sets for the narratives and oracles of the Twelve; the style guide asks for this tense decision in the first narrative record.

decisions.choice: "một người vợ đàng điếm" (L); "một người vợ lăng loàn" (B); "một người vợ sẽ không chung thủy" (R); "làm điếm" (L, B), "bất trung" (R) for zanah
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for Hosea's wife and for zanah, used through the book: plain, neither softened nor coarser than the Hebrew; Readable says what the image means, unfaithfulness, as the English Readable does. Literal prostitution elsewhere is "làm gái mại dâm".

decisions.choice: God to Hosea: "ngươi" (L), "con" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note settles for God speaking to a prophet in commissions: "ngươi" at Literal, the warmer "con" at Balanced and Readable; Hosea is "ông" in the narration. To Israel in rebuke God says "các ngươi" at every level, and "con" at Balanced and Readable only in the tender passages (2:16-25; 11:8-9; 14:5-9).

decisions.choice: "una mujer de prostitución" (L); "una esposa promiscua" (B); "una esposa que te será infiel" (R); "prostituirse" (L, B), "ser infiel" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for Hosea: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase, Balanced names the kind of wife, Readable says what she will do. The verb zanah, used of Israel turning to other gods, is "prostituirse" at Literal and Balanced and "ser infiel" at Readable through the book; literal prostitution is said plainly.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on a free pronoun (él, lo, le, su, mí, me, mi, tú, te, ti, tu)
decisions.reason: Book-wide: Spanish shows the subject in the verb ending, so an English "he" or "I" for God often has no Spanish word to carry the span; God's own "yo" takes none, as in the Spanish prophets.

decisions.choice: "음행하는 아내" (L); "음란한 아내" (B); "신실하지 않을 아내" (R); *zanah* of Israel is "음행하다" (L, B) and "신실하지 않다" (R) through Hosea
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for the Twelve: Israel's unfaithfulness to God is pictured as a wife's unfaithfulness. Literal prostitution elsewhere is said plainly ("창녀 노릇을 하다", "몸을 팔다").

decisions.choice: Narration gives God -시- and 께서; God speaks in 해라체 with 너 ("맞아들여라") and names himself without -시- ("{{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 떠나")
decisions.reason: The speech levels set for the prophets. Korean has no deity_pronoun spans; respect is carried by the honorific, so R's "그분" stands where the English has a capitalisable pronoun.

decisions.choice: "mke wa ukahaba" (L); "mke mwasherati" (B); "mke ambaye hatakuwa mwaminifu" (R); *zanah* "kufanya ukahaba" (L, B), "kutokuwa mwaminifu" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for Hosea, used through the book: Literal and Balanced keep the figure of prostitution, Readable names the unfaithfulness it stands for. Literal prostitution, where Hosea means it, is "kuwa kahaba".

decisions.choice: "uoe" (marry)
decisions.reason: "take a wife" is the ordinary Hebrew for marrying; Swahili says "kuoa". Literal keeps "ujitwalie" (take for yourself).

decisions.choice: uma mulher de prostituição, se prostitui (L); uma mulher promíscua, se entregou à prostituição (B); uma mulher que vai ser infiel, infiéis (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as the terms for Hosea set zanah and as Ezekiel 16 and Jeremiah 3:1 have it in Portuguese: Literal and Balanced keep the picture, "prostituir-se", "prostituição", and Balanced says "promíscua" for the wife where the English says "promiscuous"; Readable says what it means for Israel, "ser infiel", "infidelidade" (r-en-1). "Uma prostituta" would say more than the Hebrew, which does not use the word for a prostitute (m1). God speaks to Hosea with "tu" ("Vai", "casa", "tem").

decisions.choice: casa com (B, R); toma para ti (L)
decisions.reason: "Casar com" is the plain Brazilian way of saying "marry" (r-en-2); the reflexive "casa-te" reads as European. Literal keeps the Hebrew "toma para ti".

decisions.choice: "ዝሙት ፈጸመ" for the verb of prostitution (zanah) and "የዝሙት ሚስት" (L), "አመንዝራ ሴት" (B) for "a wife of prostitution"; R "ታማኝ ያልሆነ" where the English R says unfaithful
decisions.reason: The words the Amharic Jeremiah uses for Israel's unfaithfulness (Jeremiah 3), so that the prophets read alike; "አመነዘረ" is kept for the verb of adultery (naʾaf) where Hosea has it.

decisions.choice: वेश्यावृत्ति की पत्नी (L); व्यभिचारिणी स्त्री (B); ऐसी स्त्री जो तुमसे बेवफ़ाई करेगी (R); वेश्यावृत्ति करना (L, B), बेवफ़ा होना (R)
decisions.reason: The wording for zanah settled for Hosea: Literal and Balanced keep the picture of prostitution (वेश्यावृत्ति, as Ezekiel 16), Balanced calls the wife व्यभिचारिणी ("promiscuous"), and Readable says बेवफ़ाई ("unfaithfulness"), as Ezekiel 16 does at Readable. The Readable future "करेगी" says what the marriage would bring without deciding whether she was unfaithful before it (m1).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
decisions.reason: The English marks God's pronouns ("him") with the deity_pronoun setting. Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no such spans; respect for God is carried by the honorific third person (वे, उनके), at every level. This holds for every chapter of Hosea.

decisions.choice: жену блуда, детей блуда, блудит (L); распутной женщине, детей от блуда, предалась блуду (B); женщине, которая будет тебе изменять; изменили (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Hosea wording for zanah in Russian, as Judges 2:17, Jeremiah 3 and Ezekiel 16 have it in this translation: the "блуд" family at Literal and Balanced, and at Readable "изменять", the everyday word for a spouse's unfaithfulness. Readable's "будет тебе изменять" says what the marriage would bring and, like the English, does not decide whether she had been unfaithful before (m1).

decisions.choice: женись (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Take a wife" is the ordinary Hebrew way of saying "marry"; Balanced and Readable say "жениться", Literal keeps "возьми себе".

decisions.choice: book-wide: zanah and zenunim of Israel's unfaithfulness are "розпусничати", "розпуста" (L, B) and "бути невірним", "невірність" (R); literal prostitution is "повія" at every level (4:13-14), as Amos 7:17; hesed is "незмінна любов" (L, B), "вірна любов" (R); "говорить" (L, B), "каже" (R) after an oracle; names: Осія, Беері, Озія, Йоатам (as Matthew 1:9 and Isaiah 1:1), Гомер, Дівлаїм, Їзреел (as 1 Samuel 29), Єгу, Єфрем, Бет-Авен
decisions.reason: The English terms note gives "prostitute oneself" at Literal and Balanced and "be unfaithful" at Readable; "розпуста" says the sexual sense plainly without the older church word, and the same Ukrainian is kept through the book so the image is heard each time.

records.literal_gloss: And he went and took Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore to him a son.

en.L: So he went and took Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore to him a son.
en.B: So Hosea went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she became pregnant and bore him a son.
en.R: So Hosea married Gomer daughter of Diblaim. She became pregnant and gave birth to Hosea's son.

fr.L: Et il alla et prit Gomer fille de Diblaïm, et elle conçut et lui enfanta un fils.
fr.B: Osée alla donc épouser Gomer fille de Diblaïm ; elle devint enceinte et lui donna un fils.

sw.B: Basi Hosea alikwenda, akamwoa Gomeri binti Diblaimu, naye akapata mimba, akamzalia mtoto wa kiume.

vi.L: Vậy ông đi và lấy Gô-me con gái Đíp-la-im; nàng thụ thai và sinh cho ông một con trai.
vi.B: Vậy Ô-sê đi cưới Gô-me con gái Đíp-la-im; nàng có thai và sinh cho ông một con trai.
vi.R: Vậy Ô-sê cưới Gô-me con gái Đíp-la-im. Gô-me có thai và sinh cho Ô-sê một con trai.

es.L: Y fue y tomó a Gomer hija de Diblaim, y ella concibió y le dio a luz un hijo.
es.B: Oseas fue y se casó con Gomer hija de Diblaim, y ella quedó embarazada y le dio un hijo.
es.R: Así que Oseas se casó con Gomer hija de Diblaim. Ella quedó embarazada y le dio un hijo a Oseas.

ko.L: 그래서 그가 가서 디블라임의 딸 고멜을 맞아들였고, 그 여자가 임신하여 그에게 아들을 낳았다.
ko.B: 그래서 호세아는 가서 디블라임의 딸 고멜과 결혼했다. 고멜은 임신하여 그에게 아들을 낳아 주었다.
ko.R: 그래서 호세아는 디블라임의 딸 고멜과 결혼했다. 고멜은 임신하여 호세아의 아들을 낳았다.

pt.L: E ele foi e tomou Gômer, filha de Diblaim, e ela concebeu e lhe deu à luz um filho.
pt.B: Então Oseias foi e se casou com Gômer, filha de Diblaim, e ela engravidou e lhe deu um filho.
pt.R: Então Oseias se casou com Gômer, filha de Diblaim. Ela engravidou e deu à luz um filho de Oseias.

am.L: ሄደም፤ የዴብላይምን ልጅ ጎሜርን ወሰደ፤ እርሷም ፀነሰች፤ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደችለት።

hi.L: तब वह गया और दिबलैम की बेटी गोमेर को ले आया, और वह गर्भवती हुई और उसके लिए एक पुत्र को जन्म दिया।
hi.B: तब होशे ने जाकर दिबलैम की बेटी गोमेर से विवाह किया, और वह गर्भवती हुई और उसके लिए एक पुत्र को जन्म दिया।
hi.R: तब होशे ने दिबलैम की बेटी गोमेर से विवाह किया। वह गर्भवती हुई और उसने होशे के बेटे को जन्म दिया।

ru.B: Осия пошёл и женился на Гомери, дочери Дивлаима, и она забеременела и родила ему сына.
ru.R: Осия женился на Гомери, дочери Дивлаима. Она забеременела и родила Осии сына.

uk.L: І він пішов і взяв Гомер, дочку Дівлаїма, і вона завагітніла й народила йому сина.
uk.B: Тож Осія пішов і одружився з Гомер, дочкою Дівлаїма, і вона завагітніла й народила йому сина.
uk.R: Тож Осія одружився з Гомер, дочкою Дівлаїма. Вона завагітніла й народила Осії сина.

decisions.choice: Gomer daughter of Diblaim: a real woman, named with her father
decisions.reason: Gomer and Diblaim are named nowhere else. The account gives her name and her father's name as it would for anyone, so the marriage is told as something that happened, not as a story invented only to make a point. Unlike the children's names, her name is not explained.

decisions.choice: bore him a son: the first child is said to be Hosea's
decisions.reason: The words "to him" are not repeated for the daughter (1:6) or the second son (1:8). Some take this to hint that the later children were not Hosea's, which would fit "children of prostitution" (1:2; 2:6). The text does not say so directly.

decisions.choice: Hosea (B, R); married (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Hosea where the Hebrew says "he", and say "married" for "took" (as 1:2).

decisions.choice: "Gô-me con gái Đíp-la-im"
decisions.reason: The names as the terms note gives them; "Gô-me" is also the Genesis 10:2 form of the name.

decisions.choice: "Gomer hija de Diblaim"
decisions.reason: Gomer as the published Genesis 10:2 spells the name; Diblaim keeps the Hebrew form, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "디블라임의 딸 고멜"
decisions.reason: Protestant spellings; 고멜 is spelled as Gomer son of Japheth [1 Chr 1:5], the same Hebrew name.

decisions.choice: "Gomeri binti Diblaimu"
decisions.reason: New names take the usual Swahili ending (term sheet): a final -i after r, -u after m.

decisions.choice: Gômer, filha de Diblaim
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the names take their usual Brazilian form, "Gômer" with the accent that shows the stress on the first syllable, and "Diblaim".

decisions.choice: गोमेर, दिबलैम
decisions.reason: Gomer keeps the form of Genesis 10:2 (गोमेर); Diblaim is transcribed दिबलैम, with the dual ending as Hindi Bibles write other place-like names (महनैम).

decisions.choice: Гомерь, дочь Дивлаима
decisions.reason: The woman's name takes the feminine form "Гомерь" (genitive "Гомери"), keeping her apart from Gomer son of Japheth ("Гомер", Genesis 10:2). Diblaim is "Дивлаим", with в for the Hebrew b as in "Давид" and "Ваал".

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו קְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ יִזְרְעֶ֑אל כִּי־ע֣וֹד מְעַ֗ט וּפָ֨קַדְתִּ֜י אֶת־דְּמֵ֤י יִזְרְעֶאל֙ עַל־בֵּ֣ית יֵה֔וּא וְהִ֨שְׁבַּתִּ֔י מַמְלְכ֖וּת בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to him, Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little and I will visit the bloods of Jezreel on [the] house of Jehu, and I will put an end to [the] kingdom of [the] house of Israel.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to him, "Call his name Jezreel, for in yet a little [while] I will visit the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and I will make the kingdom of the house of Israel cease.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to him, "Name him Jezreel, for in a little while I will punish the house of Jehu for the blood shed at Jezreel, and I will bring the kingdom of the house of Israel to an end.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Hosea, "Name him Jezreel. Soon I will punish the family of King Jehu for the people they killed at Jezreel. I will bring the kingdom of Israel to an end.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui dit : « Appelle son nom Jizreël, car encore un peu [de temps] et je visiterai le sang de Jizreël sur la maison de Jéhu, et je ferai cesser le royaume de la maison d’Israël.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui dit : « Nomme-le Jizreël, car dans peu de temps je punirai la maison de Jéhu pour le sang versé à Jizreël, et je mettrai fin au royaume de la maison d’Israël.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Osée : « Appelle-le Jizreël. Bientôt, je punirai la famille du roi Jéhu pour les gens qu’ils ont tués à Jizreël. Je mettrai fin au royaume d’Israël.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia, "Mwite jina lake Yezreeli, kwa maana bado kitambo kidogo {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitailipiza damu ya Yezreeli juu ya nyumba ya Yehu, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaukomesha ufalme wa nyumba ya Israeli.
sw.B: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia, "Mpe jina Yezreeli, kwa maana baada ya muda mfupi nitaiadhibu nyumba ya Yehu kwa damu iliyomwagwa huko Yezreeli, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaukomesha ufalme wa nyumba ya Israeli.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Hosea, "Mpe jina Yezreeli. Hivi karibuni nitaiadhibu jamaa ya mfalme Yehu kwa sababu ya watu waliowaua huko Yezreeli. Nitaukomesha ufalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với ông: "Hãy gọi tên nó là Gít-rê-ên, vì chỉ còn ít [lâu] nữa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thăm phạt nhà Giê-hu về máu của Gít-rê-ên, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho vương quốc của nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên chấm dứt.
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với ông: "Hãy đặt tên nó là Gít-rê-ên, vì chẳng bao lâu nữa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt nhà Giê-hu về máu đã đổ ra tại Gít-rê-ên, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chấm dứt vương quốc của nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Ô-sê: "Con hãy đặt tên nó là Gít-rê-ên. Chẳng bao lâu nữa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt dòng họ của vua Giê-hu vì những người họ đã giết tại Gít-rê-ên. Ta sẽ chấm dứt vương quốc Y-sơ-ra-ên.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo: «Ponle por nombre Jezreel, porque dentro de poco pediré cuentas de la sangre de Jezreel a la casa de Jehú, y haré cesar el reino de la casa de Israel.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo: «Ponle por nombre Jezreel, porque dentro de poco castigaré a la casa de Jehú por la sangre derramada en Jezreel, y pondré fin al reino de la casa de Israel.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Oseas: «Ponle por nombre Jezreel. Pronto castigaré a la familia del rey Jehú por la gente que mataron en Jezreel. Pondré fin al reino de Israel.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "그의 이름을 이스르엘이라고 불러라. 조금 더 있으면 내가 이스르엘의 피를 예후의 집에 갚고, 이스라엘 집의 나라를 그치게 하겠다.
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "그 아이의 이름을 이스르엘이라고 하여라. 조금 있으면 내가 이스르엘에서 흘린 피에 대하여 예후의 집을 벌하고, 이스라엘 집의 나라를 끝내겠다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 호세아에게 말씀하셨다. "그 아이의 이름을 이스르엘이라고 지어라. 머지않아 나는 예후 왕의 집안이 이스르엘에서 사람들을 죽인 일로 그들을 벌하겠다. 나는 이스라엘 왕국을 끝내겠다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe disse: "Chama o nome dele Jezreel, porque ainda um pouco, e visitarei o sangue de Jezreel sobre a casa de Jeú e farei cessar o reino da casa de Israel.

decisions.choice: Jezreel: a town and valley where Jehu seized the throne in bloodshed; the name means "God sows"
decisions.reason: Jezreel was a royal town of the northern kingdom, above the great valley of the same name. There Jehu killed King Joram, Queen Jezebel and the family of Ahab, and so took the throne (2 Kings 9:14-10:11). Jeroboam II, king when Hosea began (1:1), was Jehu's great-grandson. The LORD had promised Jehu that his sons would rule to the fourth generation (2 Kings 10:30), and Jeroboam's son Zechariah was killed after six months as king, ending Jehu's line (2 Kings 15:8-12). The name itself means "God sows". Here it recalls bloodshed; in 2:2 and 2:24-25 the meaning "God sows" turns it into a promise.

decisions.choice: visit the blood ... on: punish for the bloodshed
decisions.reason: "Visit" something on someone means to call them to account for it, to bring its consequences on them (Exodus 20:5; Hosea 2:15). "Bloods" is plural, the usual Hebrew way of speaking of blood that has been shed.

decisions.choice: the LORD punishes Jehu's house for the killings at Jezreel, although 2 Kings 10:30 praises Jehu for ending Ahab's house
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 10:30 says that Jehu did what was right in the LORD's eyes in destroying Ahab's family, and 10:31 adds that he did not walk in the LORD's law with all his heart. Hosea does not explain how the two judgments fit. Some readers think the blood is condemned because Jehu went beyond what he was told, killing also the king of Judah and his relatives (2 Kings 9:27; 10:12-14); others think that his dynasty, having kept the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, now bears the guilt of how it began. The text names the bloodshed and leaves the reason unstated.

decisions.choice: the kingdom of the house of Israel: the northern kingdom, which ended when Assyria took Samaria in 722 BC
decisions.reason: "The house of Israel" here is the northern kingdom, distinct from Judah (1:7). Within about thirty years of Jeroboam II's death it was conquered by Assyria and its people were taken away (2 Kings 17:5-6).

decisions.choice: punish ... for the blood shed at Jezreel (B); punish ... for the people they killed at Jezreel (R)

decisions.choice: break the bow of Israel: destroy Israel's military power
decisions.reason: The bow, the weapon of the archer, stands for strength in war (1 Samuel 2:4; Jeremiah 49:35). To break it is to leave a nation defenseless. In 2:20 the LORD will break bow and sword and war themselves, so that his people can live in safety.

decisions.choice: the valley of Jezreel: the broad plain of northern Israel, a battlefield in many wars
decisions.reason: The plain below the town of Jezreel was the easiest route through the hills and saw many battles (Judges 6:33; 1 Samuel 29:1; 31:1-7). The place where Jehu's house began in blood will see Israel's army broken. The verse does not name the battle.

decisions.choice: Lo-ruhamah: "not shown compassion", "not pitied"
decisions.reason: The name is made of "not" and a form of the verb that means to show compassion, the tender love of a parent for a child (Psalm 103:13; Isaiah 49:15). The child's name announces the LORD's word about Israel: the compassion he had shown them is withdrawn. The verb returns in the same verse, "I will no longer have compassion", and in 2:3, 6 and 25, where the name is reversed.

decisions.choice: that I should in any way forgive them
alternatives: but I will surely take them away
decisions.reason: The last words are hard. The verb usually means "lift" or "carry", and "lift for them" can mean "forgive them" (as Genesis 18:24, 26). Read that way, the clause continues the sentence: no compassion, so no forgiveness at all. The same verb can also mean "carry away", and some take the clause as a new threat: "I will surely take them away", into exile. The forgiveness reading follows the usual sense of the verb with "for" a person; the other reading is possible.

decisions.choice: he said to him: the LORD said to Hosea
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not name the speaker or the hearer, but the pattern of 1:2 and 1:4 makes them plain.

decisions.choice: No Compassion (B, R); Lo-ruhamah (L)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable translate the name, by the founder's ruling for Hosea, because the book turns on what the names mean and 2:3 and 2:25 reverse them. Literal keeps the Hebrew name, with its meaning in the footnote (m1). "Compassion" is kept for the name and for the verb in the same sentence, so the reader can see the name explained. Isaiah keeps Maher-shalal-hash-baz at every level; Hosea differs on purpose.

decisions.choice: "Lo-Rouhama" (L), "Sans-Compassion" (B, R); the reversed name in 2:3 and 2:25 is "Rouhama" (L), "Compassion-Reçue" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the founder's ruling for the English: Literal keeps the Hebrew name, Balanced and Readable translate it because Hosea's message turns on it. The French name is written as one hyphenated proper name and is feminine, for a daughter.

decisions.choice: "Lô-Ru-ha-ma" (L); "Không Được Thương Xót" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the founder ruled for the English: Balanced and Readable translate the child's name, because 2:3 and 2:25 turn it around; Literal keeps the Hebrew name, whose meaning the footnote gives. In 2:3 and 2:25 it becomes "Ru-ha-ma" (L) / "Được Thương Xót" (B, R).

decisions.choice: "Lo-ruhama" (L); "No Compadecida" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the founder ruled for Hosea, Literal keeps the Hebrew name and Balanced and Readable translate it, since 2:3 and 2:25 turn on its meaning; capitals on each word, as Isaiah 62:4 does with a name that is a phrase. "Compadecida" returns as the reversed name.

decisions.choice: "로루하마" (L); "'긍휼 없음'" (B, R), written as a name, with the verb "긍휼히 여기다" kept beside it
decisions.reason: By the founder's ruling Balanced and Readable translate the children's names, because the text turns on what they mean; Literal keeps the Hebrew name and the footnote gives the meaning. Keeping "긍휼" in both the name and the verb lets the reversal in 2:3 and 2:25 be seen. Romans 9:25 has "사랑받지 못하던 여자" from the Greek.

decisions.choice: "Lo-ruhama" (L); "Asiyehurumiwa" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the Hebrew name, Balanced and Readable translate it because Hosea's message turns on what the names mean (term sheet). "Asiyehurumiwa" is "the one not shown compassion"; 2:3 and 2:25 reverse it to "Aliyehurumiwa".

decisions.choice: Lo-Ruama, Lo-Ami, Ruama, Ami (L); Sem Compaixão, Não Meu Povo, Tratada com Compaixão, Meu Povo (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, one decision for the children's names (1:6, 8, 9; 2:3, 25), as the English levels treat them (r-en-1): Literal keeps the Hebrew names, written as Portuguese spells their sounds ("Lo-Ruama", "Lo-Ami"; "Ruama", "Ami" in 2:3), with the meaning in the footnote; Balanced and Readable translate them, because the book turns on what they mean and 2:3 and 2:25 reverse them. "Sem Compaixão" keeps the word for the tender pity the verb names (m1), and the same noun "compaixão" stands in the verb ("ter compaixão", "mostrar compaixão") wherever it recurs, so the reversal can be heard; "Não Amada" would follow Romans 9:25's Greek rather than the Hebrew. "Não Meu Povo" is written without hyphens, as the English writes "Not My People", and its reversal is "Meu Povo".

decisions.choice: "ሎሩሃማ" (L); "ምሕረት ያላገኘች" (B, R); the verb "ማረ" (L), "ምሕረት አደረገ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew name and Balanced and Readable give its meaning, as the English does. The name is built on the same word as the verb, so the reader hears the name in "I will no longer have compassion"; "ምሕረት" is also the word of the Amharic 1 Peter 2:10, which echoes these names. Romans 9:25 has "ያልተወደደች" (not loved) from the Greek; the Hebrew says "not shown compassion".

decisions.choice: लो-रुहामा (L); दया-नहीं (B, R)
decisions.reason: By the founder's ruling for Hosea, Balanced and Readable translate the child's name and Literal transcribes the Hebrew (m1). The hyphenated दया-नहीं marks it as a name. The verb racham is दया करना through Hosea, so that the name, its reversal in 2:3 and 2:25, and 1 Peter 2:10 ("जिन पर दया नहीं हुई थी, पर अब दया हुई है") use one word.

decisions.choice: Ло-Рухама (L); Непомилованная (B, R); миловать, помиловать
decisions.reason: As the English levels do, Literal keeps the Hebrew name and Balanced and Readable translate it, because 2:3 and 2:25 reverse the names. "Непомилованная" is the word 1 Peter 2:10 uses for this name in this translation ("непомилованные, а ныне помилованные"), and the verb "миловать / помиловать" is used for the same Hebrew verb through the book so that the name can be heard in it.

decisions.choice: "Ло-Рухама" (L); "Непомилувана" (B, R), and "Помилувана" when 2:3 and 2:25 turn the name around
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced and Readable translate the name because the text turns on its meaning; "Непомилувана" is built on the same verb "милувати" that the sentence uses, so the name and its reason sound alike.

decisions.choice: by the LORD their God: the LORD speaks of himself by name
decisions.reason: The LORD is speaking, yet he says "by the LORD their God" rather than "by myself". Using his own name stresses who the rescuer is: Judah's safety will come from the God of the covenant, not from its own strength. Prophets often let God speak of himself in this way (Isaiah 45:3; Zechariah 10:12).

decisions.choice: not by bow, sword or battle: rescue that does not depend on weapons
decisions.reason: The list piles up the means of war, then sets them aside. The same conviction is in Psalm 20:8 and Isaiah 31:1: a people that trusts horses and chariots is not saved by them. The verse does not say when Judah would be rescued. Readers have often thought of Jerusalem's escape from the Assyrian army in Hezekiah's time (2 Kings 19:32-36), but the text does not name it.

decisions.choice: show compassion (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one in the name No Compassion (1:6). Judah receives what Israel loses. Balanced and Readable say "show compassion", matching the name.

decisions.choice: I, the LORD their God, will save them myself
decisions.reason: Readable turns the LORD's third-person reference to himself into "I, the LORD their God", so that the reader does not think another person is meant (m1). It lists bow, sword, horses and horsemen as the means of war.

decisions.choice: "그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}로" (L); "…{{divine_name:주|야훼}}로서" (B); "…{{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 내가 직접" (R)
decisions.reason: God speaks of himself by name; Korean keeps the name without -시- in his own mouth, and B and R make plain that the speaker is the one who saves.

decisions.choice: "họ" for Judah
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps "chúng" for the guilty in the oracles and "họ" for those God promises to save, so Judah here is "họ" beside the condemned house of Israel ("chúng", verse 6).

decisions.choice: "Mimi" written plainly; span on "mwenyewe" only
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb, and a prefix takes no capital, so deity_pronoun spans go only on free pronouns; a pronoun that opens a sentence is capitalised anyway. Hosea therefore has fewer spans than the English. Noted once for the book. Mid-sentence, every free pronoun or possessive that means God takes the span, including "nami", "naye", "yeye" and "kwangu"; a word that opens a sentence is written plainly with its capital, and "naye" followed by a noun ("naye BWANA") is a conjunction with no span.

decisions.choice: eu mesmo, with no setting
decisions.reason: The English Readable puts "myself" under the deity_pronoun setting. Portuguese "eu mesmo" is the emphatic "I", and "eu" for God takes no span (docs/portuguese-style.md §7), as Ezekiel 16:60 has it, so there is no counterpart.

decisions.choice: Я, ГОСПОДЬ, их Бог, сам спасу их (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable does, Readable turns the LORD's speaking of himself in the third person into "Я, ГОСПОДЬ", so that no one thinks another person is meant (m1). The reflexive "сам" takes no deity_pronoun span.

records.literal_gloss: And she weaned Lo-ruhamah, and she conceived and bore a son.

en.L: And she weaned Lo-ruhamah, and she conceived and bore a son.
en.B: After Gomer had weaned No Compassion, she became pregnant and gave birth to a son.
en.R: After Gomer stopped nursing No Compassion, she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son.

fr.L: Et elle sevra Lo-Rouhama, et elle conçut et enfanta un fils.
fr.B: Après avoir sevré Sans-Compassion, Gomer devint enceinte et donna naissance à un fils.
fr.R: Quand Gomer a eu fini d’allaiter Sans-Compassion, elle est de nouveau devenue enceinte et elle a donné naissance à un fils.

sw.L: Akamwachisha Lo-ruhama kunyonya, akapata mimba, akazaa mwana.
sw.B: Gomeri alipomwachisha Asiyehurumiwa kunyonya, alipata mimba, akazaa mtoto wa kiume.
sw.R: Gomeri alipoacha kumnyonyesha Asiyehurumiwa, alipata mimba tena, akazaa mtoto wa kiume.

vi.L: Nàng cai sữa Lô-Ru-ha-ma, rồi thụ thai và sinh một con trai.
vi.B: Sau khi Gô-me cai sữa Không Được Thương Xót, nàng có thai và sinh một con trai.
vi.R: Sau khi thôi cho Không Được Thương Xót bú, Gô-me lại có thai và sinh một con trai.

es.L: Y destetó a Lo-ruhama, y concibió y dio a luz un hijo.
es.B: Después de destetar a No Compadecida, Gomer quedó embarazada y dio a luz un hijo.
es.R: Cuando Gomer dejó de amamantar a No Compadecida, volvió a quedar embarazada y dio a luz un niño.

pt.R: Depois que Gômer parou de amamentar Sem Compaixão, ela engravidou outra vez e deu à luz um filho.

decisions.choice: weaned: the time between the children was some years
decisions.reason: Mothers nursed their children much longer than is common today; Hannah kept Samuel at home until he was weaned and then brought him to the house of the LORD (1 Samuel 1:22-24), and weaning was often at two or three years. The note marks the passing of time between the second and third child.

decisions.choice: No Compassion (B, R); Lo-ruhamah (L)
decisions.reason: The name is translated at Balanced and Readable and kept in Hebrew at Literal, as in 1:6. Readable says "stopped nursing" for "weaned" and adds "again", which the verb implies.

decisions.choice: Lo-ammi: "not my people"
decisions.reason: The name is made of "not" and "my people". The words that follow explain it. Its reversal is promised in 2:1, 3 and 25.

decisions.choice: you are not my people, and I will not be yours: the covenant promise turned around
decisions.reason: The covenant was summed up in the words "I will be your God, and you will be my people" (Exodus 6:7; Leviticus 26:12). Here both halves are denied. The verb "I will be" is the same form God uses when he gives his name to Moses, "I am who I am" (Exodus 3:14), and the words can also be heard as "I am not 'I AM' to you". Either way, the relationship that made Israel the LORD's people is declared broken.

decisions.choice: he said ... you: the LORD speaks to Israel through the child's name
decisions.reason: The speaker is the LORD, as in 1:4 and 1:6. "You" is plural: it addresses the people, not the child.

decisions.choice: Not My People (B, R); Lo-ammi (L)
decisions.reason: As in 1:6, Balanced and Readable translate the name and Literal keeps the Hebrew with the meaning in the footnote (m1).

decisions.choice: I will not be your God
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "I will not be to you". Readable supplies "God" from the covenant words the sentence echoes (m2); Literal and Balanced say "I will not be yours".

decisions.choice: "Lô-Am-mi" (L); "Không Phải Dân Ta" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 6: Balanced and Readable translate the name, Literal keeps the Hebrew one with its meaning in the footnote. The "Ta" inside the name is part of the name, capitalised, and takes no deity_pronoun span. In 2:3 and 2:25 it becomes "Am-mi" (L) / "Dân Ta" (B, R).

decisions.choice: "Lo-ammi" (L); "No Es Mi Pueblo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As at 1:6: Literal keeps the Hebrew name, Balanced and Readable translate it, capitalizing each word; the reversal in 2:25 reads "Mi Pueblo".

decisions.choice: plural "you" with the plural_you setting
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks to the whole people through the child's name, and the Hebrew "you" is plural, so every plural "you" in Hosea is a plural_you span: ustedes forms by default, vosotros forms as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "로암미" (L); "'내 백성 아님'" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same rule as "긍휼 없음" in 1:6: the name is translated at Balanced and Readable so that 2:1 and 2:25 can reverse it.

decisions.choice: "너희의 [하나님이] 되지 않을" (L)
decisions.reason: Korean cannot leave "I will not be yours" without a noun; Literal brackets the covenant word the sense supplies.

decisions.choice: "Lo-ami" (L); "Si Watu Wangu" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 1:6: the name is translated at Balanced and Readable. "Wangu" inside the name is part of the name and takes no deity_pronoun span; the same words in the sentence that follows do. Romans 9:25-26 says "si watu wangu".

decisions.choice: "ninyi si watu wangu" with no brackets
decisions.reason: Swahili's negative copula "si" carries the Hebrew "not", so the English bracketed [are] has no separate Swahili word to bracket.

decisions.choice: "Lo-Ammi" (L), "Pas-Mon-Peuple" (B, R); reversed in 2:25 as "Ammi" (L), "Mon-Peuple" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 1:6: Balanced and Readable translate the name because the message is in it; "Pas-Mon-Peuple" keeps the words "mon peuple" that 2:1 and 2:25 turn around.

decisions.choice: "vous" where the Hebrew addresses Israel in the plural, "tu" where it addresses Israel, Ephraim or the mother in the singular, switching inside a verse when the Hebrew does, throughout Hosea
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for these books: French "tu" and "vous" follow the Hebrew's number, so the shifts Hosea makes between the nation and its people stay visible.

decisions.choice: vocês (the LORD to Israel through the child's name)
decisions.reason: The "you" here is plural and addresses the people, not the child (m3), so Portuguese turns from "tu", said to Hosea, to "vocês". The name "Não Meu Povo" takes no deity_pronoun span, being a name.

decisions.choice: "ሎዓሚ" (L); "ሕዝቤ ያልሆነ" (B, R); plural "እናንተ" in "you are not my people"
decisions.reason: The name's meaning in the words of the Amharic Romans 9:25 ("ሕዝቤ ያልሆኑትን"). The Hebrew "you" here is plural: the LORD speaks to the people through the child's name.

decisions.choice: लो-अम्मी (L); मेरी-प्रजा-नहीं (B); मेरे-लोग-नहीं (R)
alternatives: one translated name at both Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As in 1:6, Literal transcribes the name and Balanced and Readable translate it. God's "my people" is मेरी प्रजा at Literal and Balanced and मेरे लोग at Readable, as Romans 9:25-26 quotes Hosea at each level, so the name follows the level's word for "my people" and 2:1 and 2:25 can reverse it word for word.

decisions.choice: Ло-Амми (L); Не-мой-народ (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:6, Literal keeps the Hebrew name and Balanced and Readable translate it. The translated name is written with hyphens so that it reads as a name; the same words "не мой народ" are what Romans 9:25-26 quotes in this translation.

decisions.choice: вы не мой народ
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" here is plural, addressed to the people, so Russian says "вы", as Romans 9:26 does in this translation.

decisions.choice: "Ло-Аммі" (L); "Не Мій Народ" (B, R), and "Мій Народ" in 2:3 and 2:25
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced and Readable translate the name; the words "ви не Мій народ" match the Ukrainian Romans 9:26.
